adapter.registration: unregistered developer-only fixture; not an audio-bench result

state_leakage_across_sessions.note: Sessions are keyed by session_id plus canonical control digest; continued calls replay buffered samples before emitting the new suffix. The first segment of a split call is provisional because its gain was computed before the later samples existed; only the replayed suffix is expected to match the one-shot result.

nonfinite_input.note: Finite-only RMS planning plus C++-style min/max ordering maps NaN/Inf inputs to the finite ceiling. This is an observation, not a robustness endorsement.

peak_overshoot.note: Overshoot and impulse cases demand a static scale that exceeds the ceiling; the hard clamp is the observable guard.

silence_and_near_silence.note: Whole-segment floor bypass is explicit. Quiet spans inside an active segment are still scaled by the bounded static gain and are not gated.

baseline_comparison.reason: Identity and energy-matched synthetic controls are reported; no established baseline parity, frozen cohort, listening acceptance or loudness-standard conformance is claimed.

ceiling_sweep.note: Hard clamp after scaling; impulse and overshoot cases include limiting. Float32 rounding may leave a few 1e-8 units of measured headroom.

delay.note: Static per-segment scaling with a hard clamp has no lookahead; content delay is not availability latency or acoustic phase/group delay.

interacting_nonlinear.note: Static chaining through the adapter boundary only. The hard ceiling and sequence-static RMS make stage order observable; no native chain, real-time interaction or listening claim is made.

level_sweep.note: Independent deterministic 1 kHz tone levels; gain is recomputed per call. Rows at the bounds demonstrate bounded scaling, not target convergence; the lowest row is suppressed by the explicit silence floor.

load_and_energy_matched_control.note: Synthetic energy-matched and identity controls only. Not STOI, SI-SDR, intelligibility, loudness-standard conformance, listening, CPU load or deadline evidence.
load_and_energy_matched_control.stimulus: deterministic harmonic-burst synthetic speech with +/-9 dB gain steps

response.note: Chirp band RMS ratios describe a static gain over nonlinear clipping; not a linear transfer function or EQ measurement.

state_transitions.note: A reset splits the static measurement window. There is no adaptive state inside a segment; reset changes the measured RMS and the resulting gain.

target_sweep.note: Fixed synthetic tone with varied explicit target; bound-limited rows are reported as limit cases and never promoted as converged targets.

exact_gain_arithmetic.nonfinite_policy: finite-only RMS; C++-style min/max ordering maps nonfinite products to the ceiling
exact_gain_arithmetic.silence_bypass: if input_rms_db <= silence_floor_dbfs, emit zeros and do not amplify

missing_result_policy: No missing, rejected, not_run or incomplete result qualifies a candidate; every absent real/listening/native/device qualification remains blocked.

task_board.note: Read-time provenance only; never a qualification or gating source.
